title: Best Video Template Editors (2026): Customize Templates Fast
description: How to hire someone to customize video templates for intros, promos or social ads: licenses, branding, formats, how to brief it and red flags.
intro: Video template editors customize ready-made templates from editing software or template libraries: intros, promos, slideshows, social ads and lower thirds. It is a fast, affordable way to get polished videos. Projects go wrong when the template license does not cover your use, branding is not applied consistently, or the result looks like everyone else's video. This guide helps you get template videos that look on brand and are legal to use.

faq.q: Can the template be fully changed?
faq.a: Most allow text, colors, images and music changes. Big structural changes may be easier with custom work.
